# Sourav Dutta

> Full Stack Developer based in Kolkata, India. Specializes in building fast, privacy-focused, and robust web applications, browser extensions, and developer utilities using Next.js, Node.js, React, and MongoDB.

- [Portfolio Home](https://sourav.dev): Official portfolio website of Sourav Dutta.

- [Personal Blog](https://blog.sourav.dev): Articles, tutorials, and development thoughts.

## Projects

- [Caption Extractor](https://sourav.dev/projects/caption-extractor): Utility to extract and download Instagram captions. Live at https://caption.dsourav.com
- [RojLekho (Daily Journal)](https://sourav.dev/projects/rojlekho): Secure, end-to-end encrypted private journaling app. Live at https://rojlekho.com
- [Intro Skipper](https://sourav.dev/projects/intro-skipper): Browser extension to automatically skip intros on streaming platforms. Live at https://introskipper.dsourav.com
- [URL Expander](https://sourav.dev/projects/url-expander): Security tool to expand and inspect shortened URLs. Live at https://url.dsourav.com
- [PocketUtils](https://sourav.dev/projects/pocketutils): Collection of 100% client-side privacy-first web utilities. Live at https://pocketutils.com
- [Email Sandbox](https://sourav.dev/projects/email-sandbox): SMTP testing platform that captures transactional email in test inboxes for inspection without sending to real recipients. Live at https://email.dsourav.com
- [Personal Blog](https://sourav.dev/projects/personal-blog): Custom blog built to share web development articles and tutorials. Live at https://blog.sourav.dev
